observation_examples: member joined or left group observed
intention_examples: sender intends to deliver message to recipients
admin intends to change group membership
participant intends to acknowledge or react to message
commitment_examples: service commits eventual delivery attempts under policy
group admin commits moderation actions under role authority
client commits end-to-end encrypted payload publication with metadata envelope

conflict_shape.example: concurrent admin actions on same user (remove vs promote)
conflict_shape.expected_behavior: both actions remain visible with causal ordering; policy resolves effective state

replay_shape.example: reconstruct group state and moderation history from immutable records
replay_shape.expected_behavior: deterministic replay produces auditable timeline of membership, intents, and commitments

notes: Messaging/group coordination is a natural TRS fit when transport/crypto remain profile layers and TRS models coordination truth.
